info.title: Pinch Payments Universal API
info.description: Manage merchants, payers, payments, payment links, refunds, events, and related payment operations in Pinch Payments.

post.description: Creates or updates a payer in Pinch Payments.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

companyRegistrationNumber.description: Company registration number for the payer.

id.description: If you include an ID this endpoint updates an existing payer; otherwise it creates a new payer.

source.ipAddress.description: IP address associated with the payment source.

source.sourceType.description: Currently either bank-account or credit-card when creating a payment source with the payer.

source.token.description: Token created by the capture script when adding a payment source with the payer.
